ci(native): settle apt-outage failures into a bounded browser-only fallback (#11064)

* ci(pack): survive hosted-runner apt outages with a bounded browser-only fallback

Since ~13:45Z 2026-11-11 GitHub-hosted runners intermittently cannot
resolve any Ubuntu archive, so the apt stage of 'playwright install
--with-deps chromium' killed whole packs before any test ran (run
43039248114: packs 1,2,3,4,5,7,8,10 red). Give every shell-executed
install the bounded fallback proven in terminal PR #1469: a 240s
TERM-bounded --with-deps attempt, then a ::warning and a 60s
browser-only install. The hosted image already ships Chromium's system
libraries, so a genuinely missing library fails the launch visibly.
The three acquisition: native_parallel contract installs stay
byte-identical (run_ci_pack validates their exact run token; they do
not shell out to apt directly).

tests/test_ci_browser_setup.py pins the census (7 fallback installs +
3 exact native tokens) and executes both real step shapes under mocked
installers across full/browser exit-code combinations. Four owners
crossed an 800-character planner bucket (+1 each); PACKING_PROBES
weight ceilings funded with the measured +1/+2/+1 (137/138/131 jobs,
ten packs unchanged).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Code <noreply@anthropic.com>

* ci: run test_ci_browser_setup.py in ci-control-plane-structure

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* ci(native): settle apt-outage failures into a bounded browser-only fallback

During a hosted-runner Ubuntu-archive resolution outage, the native browser
setup turned any nonzero apt exit into UPDATE_UNPROVEN/RESOLUTION_UNPROVEN
(or burned the whole total bound in completion retries) and returned an
unknown settlement, which poisoned every remaining job in the pack (~20
unrelated "infrastructure unknown" failures per affected pack).

A native apt child that exited with a returncode is settled, not unknown:
update/resolve apply no packages, and an acquisition whose install stage
never started, with no pending child and every reaped observation settled
(downloads rc=100/FETCH, completion retry also failing), provably applied
nothing. Both classes now emit ::warning and attempt the incumbent
browser-only chromium install under the remaining original deadline; a
failed fallback is a settled job-local failure so sibling jobs keep
running. Genuinely unknown cases (unreaped children, killed stages,
started/unknown installation) stay fail-closed. The update stage also
gains bounded Acquire::Retries/Timeout options so a resolution outage
exits nonzero by itself instead of hanging to the total bound.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Code <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(ci): require a settled completion response before browser fallback

Keep missing and unknown completion observations unknown on both sides of the original deadline. Allow positively observed nonzero completion exits after settled downloads.

* ci(native): limit settled-stage fallback to package-free stages; pin update argv

Review follow-ups on top of 96f93254: stage_settled_failure now requires the
stage name and only accepts update/resolve (provably package-free), drops a
dead detail assignment, and pins the bounded apt update argv in a test.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

---------

Co-authored-by: chriswong6031-creator <chriswong6031@gmail.com>
Co-authored-by: Claude Code <noreply@anthropic.com>
Co-authored-by: MastermindX1 <team1@mastermind-x.com>

+# Verdict — "X grant number is real" gate
+
+**As of:** 2026-11-12 (MST) · **Card:** kanban `t_e305794e` (XG registry content v1) · **Gathered:** read-only, worktree `/Users/chriswong/.hermes/profiles/marketing/cache/scratch/xg-wt` @ branch `xg/runtime-adapter-v1`, HEAD `254d89c473`
+
+VERDICT: **GATE NOT SATISFIED — no real grant on record as of 2026-11-12**
+
+No X/Twitter API grant number, pack number, invoice, paid-tier receipt, entitlement read-back, or vendor Enterprise quote for this programme exists anywhere on disk. Every mention is one of: (a) a recommendation/budget/modelling assumption, (b) a documented limitation with entitlement explicitly *unresolved*, or (c) a proposal explicitly marked unapproved. Category (c) of the brief — a REAL issued/paid entitlement with a number or receipt — has **zero** occurrences.
+
+## Evidence
+
+| # | Citation (exact) | Class | What it establishes |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| 1 | `research/agentic_media/research/X_API_FOLLOW_LIMITS_BRIEF_2026-11.md:3` | (b) | "This is a planning brief. **No account was accessed, credits purchased or platform action tested.**" |
+| 2 | `research/agentic_media/research/X_API_FOLLOW_LIMITS_BRIEF_2026-11.md:13` | (b) | "**Minimum pack and Enterprise quote remain UNRESOLVED.** The earlier $42,000–$50,000 Enterprise figures were third-party reports, not a vendor quote for this programme." — no pack id, no quote number |
+| 3 | `research/agentic_media/research/X_API_FOLLOW_LIMITS_BRIEF_2026-11.md:11` | (a) | The $5 credit pack + single-follow probe is "**unapproved future work**" |

+| 6 | `research/agentic_media/X_GUERRILLA_NETWORK_MASTERPLAN.md:466` (§22.3) | (b) | "Actual account checkout, features and eligibility remain **UNVERIFIED**. Do not buy a tier or infer reach from the $8 modelling unit." |
+| 7 | `research/agentic_media/X_GUERRILLA_NETWORK_MASTERPLAN.md:234` | (a) | Vendor follow/unfollow "60 credits, $0.0006/call — Published endpoint price; **no account action or invoice tested**" |
+| 8 | `research/agentic_media/X_GUERRILLA_NETWORK_MASTERPLAN.md:384` (§18.6) | (a)/(b) | "$8 unit is an **unverified modelling assumption, not proof of tier eligibility**, checkmark or approved subscription"; seat cap remains a proposal |
+| 9 | `research/agentic_media/X_GUERRILLA_NETWORK_MASTERPLAN.md:382` (§18.4) | (a) | "$50–75 minimum pack … remain **separate unapproved spend**"; new purchase receipt not established |
+| 10 | `research/agentic_media/X_GUERRILLA_NETWORK_MASTERPLAN.md:255` | (a) | Buffer $6/$4/$3/$1 bands are "author-reported **illustrative model, not a currently verified checkout**… Actual connected/billed inventory and invoice remain unverified" |
+| 11 | `research/agentic_media/research/X_AUTOMATION_RAILS_2026-11.md:66` | (b) | Comparison row: "Current programme status \| **No new account entitlement proved**" |
+| 12 | `research/agentic_media/research/X_AUTOMATION_RAILS_2026-11.md:5` | (b) | "A capability comparison **is not an execution grant**"; brief "admits no account, browser, credentials, spending or live action" |
+| 13 | `research/agentic_media/research/X_PUBLISHING_SCALE_DECISION_2026-11-07.md:25` | (b) | "Actual connected inventory, plan, tax, billing cycle and invoice must be read before a purchase… **This correction did not access a billing account.**" |
+| 14 | kanban `t_da720ee4` comment, engineering, 2026-11-08 04:52:55 | (b) | Preconditions table row: "**X grant number real \| NO**" citing brief `:9,13,28`, masterplan `:268,466`, rails `:66` |
+| 15 | kanban `t_e305794e` comment, marketing, 2026-11-10 09:43:55 | (b) | "**X grant number: not real.**" Cites `:20`, `:268`, `:466`; notes this does **not** block a `proposed`-state registry but does block any advance to `admitted`/`suspended` |

+| 17 | commit `8f12b4e2a1` (squash of PR #10947, merged 2026-11-10T10:28:44Z) | disposition | Registry content landed **only** because it is inert: engineering review (`t_e305794e`, 2026-11-10 10:15:32) records "landing it **enables no live action and does not satisfy or waive the grant gate**" |
+| 18 | kanban `t_fd170576` ("X posting gate — endpoint permission + entitlement + spend + credential custody") | blocked | Still `blocked`, no `completed_at`, opened 2026-11-08 04:36; the gate item itself has never closed |
+| 19 | commit `254d89c473`, 2026-11-11 18:57 MST (HEAD, newest XG work) | (b) | New adapter binds "content-pinned admission receipts ({path, sha256})" before any effect — structurally presumes a receipt that does not exist; adds refusals, not an entitlement |
+| 20 | `research/admissions/` | absent | Directory does not exist; `git log --all -- research/admissions` is **empty** — no admission receipt has ever been committed |
+
+Absence checks run and returning nothing: `git grep` over `research/agentic_media/*` and `tools/xguerrilla/*` for `pack[_ -]?id`, `entitlement[_ -]?id`, `invoice`, `order[_ -]?(id|number)`, `purchase receipt`, `credits? purchased`, `billing account`, `INV-[0-9]` — only the "no invoice tested / unverified" prose rows above. Kanban: no task created on/after 2026-11-10 mentioning X API grant, pack, enterprise, or entitlement status change. Git: only one commit touched `tools/xguerrilla/`/`research/agentic_media/` since 2026-11-10 (`254d89c473`), and it contains no entitlement.
+
+## What a marginal reader might mistake for the gate, and why it isn't
+
+- **PR #10947 merged (`8f12b4e2a1`) → `t_e305794e` is `done`.** The card's *content* deliverable was always gated on "proposed"-state records, and every record is `state: proposed` with `admission_receipt: null`. The reviewing engineer stated the sequencing gate "is still unmet" in the same breath as approving. Card completion ≠ gate satisfaction.
+- **Published X API unit prices ($0.015 create, $0.200 URL post, $0.010 read).** These are public tariff rows; brief `:5` and masterplan `:20` both say a price row is not an entitlement, and `:13`/`:268` say this account's minimum purchase and Enterprise quote are unresolved.
+- **$350 / $347.56 / $8-per-seat figures.** Explicitly labelled recommendation and unverified modelling unit (`:384`, `:466`, §18.3, §22.4) — no purchase, no approval, no checkout.
+
+## What would satisfy the gate
+
+1. **An account-specific entitlement read-back** from the X developer portal for the actual account/app: plan name, tier, and confirmation that follow/like/quote endpoints are enabled for *this* account — stored as a dated receipt (not a screenshot of a price page).
+2. **Or a purchase receipt / invoice with an identifier** — pack number, invoice number, or Enterprise order/SOW reference — showing money actually paid to X for the programme's API access, plus the credit balance read back from the account.
+3. **Then** at least one `admission_receipt: {path, sha256}` committed under `research/admissions/`, which flips one registry entry from `proposed` to `admitted` and makes `XG-W8` (rail proof) executable.
+4. Failing 1–3, an explicit **Chairman waiver** recorded in a decision record — that would satisfy the *programme* gate by ruling it unnecessary, but it must be a written ruling, not an inference from merged docs.
+
+Until one of those exists, the gate is NOT SATISFIED. No grant number, pack id, or price has been invented here.
+
+---
+*Method note: prior child attempt (2026-11-10) died on a provider 429 before any tool call; this verdict was gathered fresh. Read-only throughout — no writes in the worktree, no git mutations.*

@@ -117,6 +117,77 @@ class Pending:
     eof: bool = False
 
 
+# The exact browser-only vendor command of the incumbent bounded fallback: the
+# hosted image's preinstalled Chromium system libraries replace the apt stage.
+BROWSER_ONLY_INSTALL_COMMAND = "python -m playwright install chromium"
+
+
+# Only these stages are provably package-free: update refreshes indexes and
+# resolve is --print-uris. Never extend this to a stage that can run dpkg.
+PACKAGE_FREE_STAGES = frozenset({"update", "resolve"})
+
+
+def stage_settled_failure(stage_result: dict, mode: str) -> bool:
+    """A native apt stage child that exited nonzero by itself, reaped with a
+    returncode, is SETTLED: ``update``/``resolve`` apply no packages, so the
+    failure proves nothing was installed and the browser-only fallback is
+    safe. Unreaped children, lost responses and deadline kills raise before
+    this point and keep their unknown settlement."""
+    return (mode in PACKAGE_FREE_STAGES
+            and type(stage_result) is dict and stage_result.get("outcome") == "failed"
+            and stage_result.get("settlement") == "settled")
+
+
+def acquisition_settled_failure_without_applied_packages(result) -> bool:
+    """Require positive settlement of every launched stage before fallback."""
+    if result.installation != "never_started" or result.pending or not result.observations:
+        return False
+    if any(outcome not in {"passed", "failed"} or settlement != "settled"
+           for _index, outcome, settlement in result.observations):
+        return False
+
+    completion = result.completion
+    if completion is None:
+        return result.settlement == "settled" and result.initial_download_failure is None
+    if completion.settlement != "settled" or completion.outcome not in {"passed", "failed"}:
+        return False
+    # The acquisition core marks an unsuccessful completion unproven even when
+    # its process returned a settled nonzero exit. Only that positive receipt
+    # distinguishes this case from a lost response to the completion stage.
+    return result.settlement == "settled" or (
+        result.reason == "NATIVE_COMPLETION_UNPROVEN"
+        and result.initial_download_failure == "NATIVE_DOWNLOAD_FAILED"
+        and completion.outcome == "failed"
+    )
+
+
+def _browser_only_after_settled_failure(*, reason: str, evidence: str, deadline: float,
+                                        command_env: dict, browser_stream) -> dict:
+    """After a SETTLED apt failure with no packages applied, attempt the same
+    bounded browser-only install as the incumbent fallback path.
+
+    The remaining original setup deadline bounds this single attempt. A failed
+    fallback is a settled job-local failure (siblings in the pack keep
+    running); a genuinely unsettled fallback observation keeps its unknown
+    settlement and never degrades the fail-closed contract.
+    """
+    remaining = deadline - time.monotonic()
+    if remaining <= 0:
+        return {"outcome": "timed_out", "returncode": None, "failure_signature": None,
+                "timeout_settlement": "not_started",
+                "detail": f"native cold acquisition settled failure ({reason}); {evidence}; "
+                          "original total exhausted before the browser-only fallback could start"}
+    print(f"::warning title=native-browser-setup::{reason}; no packages applied; "
+          "attempting browser-only chromium install", flush=True)
+    observation = browser_stream(BROWSER_ONLY_INSTALL_COMMAND, env=command_env, timeout_seconds=remaining)
+    return {"outcome": observation.outcome, "returncode": observation.returncode,
+            "failure_signature": observation.failure_signature,
+            "timeout_settlement": observation.timeout_settlement,
+            "detail": f"native cold acquisition settled failure ({reason}); {evidence}; "
+                      f"browser-only fallback {observation.outcome}; "
+                      + (observation.detail or f"browser acquisition {observation.outcome}")}
+
+

         if not re.fullmatch(r"/tmp/ci-apt-[A-Za-z0-9_-]+", root):

-        if result.outcome != "passed":
-            return {"outcome": result.outcome, "returncode": None if result.settlement == "unknown" or result.outcome == "timed_out" else 1, "failure_signature": None,
-                    "timeout_settlement": "unknown" if result.settlement == "unknown" else None,
-                    "detail": f"native cold acquisition {result.reason}{original_detail}; downloads[index,returncode,reported_errors]={json.dumps(failed_download_summaries(backend.records), separators=(',', ':'))}; installation={result.installation}; retained {root}; pending={result.pending}; handles={backend.handles}; native_children={[(i, r.get('child_pid')) for i, r in backend.records.items() if type(r.get('child_pid')) is int and 0 < r['child_pid'] <= 2147483647]}"}
+        if settled_failure is None:
+            resolved = backend.stage("resolve", deadline)
+            if stage_settled_failure(resolved, "resolve"):
+                settled_failure = f"apt resolve exited {resolved.get('returncode')} settled with no packages applied"

+                result = acquire_and_install(backend.plan, backend, deadline=deadline)
+                installation = result.installation
+                if result.initial_download_failure is not None:
+                    completion = result.completion
+                    original_detail = (f"; initial_download_failure={result.initial_download_failure}; "
+                                       f"completion={completion.outcome if completion else 'unknown'}/{completion.settlement if completion else 'unknown'}")
+                    original_attempt_detail = original_detail + f"; original_downloads={json.dumps(failed_download_summaries(backend.records), separators=(',', ':'))}; retained {root}"
+                if result.outcome != "passed":
+                    if acquisition_settled_failure_without_applied_packages(result):
+                        settled_failure = f"native acquisition {result.reason} with every native child settled and no packages applied"
+                    else:
